title: Give a Hand & Give Help
situation: Helping a teammate during a busy shift.
objective: Use give a hand and give help to offer assistance at work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When a teammate is busy, I give a hand with the tools.
dialogue.indonesian: Saat rekan kerja sibuk, saya membantu dengan alat-alat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I give help when a task needs two people.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya memberi bantuan saat tugas membutuhkan dua orang.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My teammate gives me a hand with the heavy box.
dialogue.indonesian: Rekan kerja saya membantu saya dengan kotak yang berat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: We give help to the new staff in the work area.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami memberi bantuan kepada staf baru di area kerja.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: It is good to give a hand before someone asks.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik untuk membantu sebelum seseorang meminta.

learningNotes: give a hand berarti membantu, sama seperti give help, tetapi give a hand lebih santai.
Untuk give a hand, objek orang langsung mengikuti: give me a hand.
Untuk give help, gunakan give help to + orang: give help to the new staff.
